long_biography.plain_text:
At Domino's Pizza Group, Stephen Glen Hemsley turned financial expertise into operational leadership. He joined the then-private company as finance director in 1998, led its AIM flotation the following year and became chief executive two years later. The chain expanded from about 100 outlets to more than 1,000 during his long association, while moving from AIM into the FTSE 250.

Hemsley and Nigel Wray established Franchise Brands in 2008 to apply that franchising experience across multiple businesses. He guided its own AIM listing and a series of acquisitions that broadened the portfolio from consumer franchises into drainage, plumbing, pump maintenance and commercial kitchen services. With day-to-day management delegated to a group chief executive, his executive-chairman brief centres on strategy, finance and future acquisitions.
